findings.statement: Entity type on file is Individual (sole proprietor), for which no Connecticut state entity registration is expected; CT trade names (DBAs) are filed with the town clerk rather than the Secretary of the State, so they are not searchable in the state registry. The Connecticut online business search at service.ct.gov could not be loaded by automation in this session, so no state-register check of 'Hooked and Company' was completed. No registration deficiency is assumed for a sole proprietor.
findings.establishes: No state registration is expected for an individual/sole proprietor; the CT registry itself could not be queried.

findings.statement: The declared shop page (hookedbychristineco.etsy.com, canonical form www.etsy.com/shop/HookedByChristineCo) could not be retrieved in this session: the research fetch tool refused the URL for provenance reasons, and a direct browser load was not permitted on this unattended run. Repeated web searches, including domain-restricted searches of etsy.com, instagram.com and facebook.com, did not surface the shop, any listing, or any social page. Because the shop page was never actually loaded, the 'online-only seller with no observable product' contradiction is deliberately NOT applied - the failure is a tooling and access limitation, not a confirmed absence of the shop. No independent listing, social page or craft-fair vendor list places this seller in or near Farmington, CT. A manual browser check is required.
findings.establishes: Neither the existence nor the absence of an operating storefront could be confirmed; the shop URL was not reachable and no independent footprint was found by search.

findings.statement: The representative could not be matched to any role on a public source: no Etsy shop About or owner section could be loaded, and searches for the representative together with crochet, handmade, craft-fair vendor and Connecticut terms returned no matching maker, vendor listing, local news item or complaint report. Nothing found contradicts the representative either - no public source ties the representative to a different business, another city or state, or to any scam, complaint or fraud report. The declared shop name embeds a first name matching the representative's first name, but that is a name coincidence inside a merchant-supplied URL, not independent corroboration. Identity documents and bank ownership are verified only by Stripe (status: verified).
findings.establishes: No independent public link between the representative and the business was found, and nothing contradicts the representative.

findings.statement: The declared URL could not be loaded in this session, so it could not be confirmed to resolve or to belong to this seller; equally, there is no evidence it is parked, a site-builder placeholder, or another business's site. The statement descriptor HOOKEDBYCHRISTINECO.ET is a clean 22-character truncation of the declared Etsy subdomain hookedbychristineco.etsy.com and is not a random string, and the email handle is consistent with the representative on file; descriptor, URL and email handle are internally coherent with the declared business. No fictitious contact details were observed.
findings.establishes: Descriptor and declared URL cohere with each other, but the site itself was never loaded, so ownership of the storefront is unconfirmed.

findings.statement: MCC 5399 (miscellaneous general merchandise) is a plausible fit for a handmade crochet or fibre-goods Etsy seller, and nothing observed suggests the business is incoherent with that code. However, no shop listings could be loaded, the product description field is null, and no catalogue or social page showing what is actually sold could be observed, so coherence could not be positively confirmed. The business name and email handle describe a craft ('hooked' being a crochet term), not payment collection, so no payment-facilitation flag applies.
findings.establishes: MCC 5399 is plausible for the declared trade but no observable product range was available to confirm it.

findings.statement: No dated reviews, listings, Etsy 'on Etsy since' year, filings or any other dated independent presence could be found for this seller. No scam, complaint or fraud report about this business or its owner was found. A BBB profile exists for an unrelated 'Hooked & Company' book and media subscription club listed in Danbury, CT with billing and delivery complaints; that is a different trade, a different city and a different business type, it was not loaded, and it was not treated as evidence about this merchant.
findings.establishes: No trading history of any length could be established, and no adverse history was found.

evidenceNeeded: Manual browser check of https://hookedbychristineco.etsy.com/ and https://www.etsy.com/shop/HookedByChristineCo - confirm the shop loads, is active (not 'currently not selling'), shows live crochet/handmade listings, and record the 'On Etsy since' year, sales count and star rating. This is the single check that most changes the score: a confirmed active shop clears the operating dimension, while a confirmed absent or inactive shop makes it a 15-point contradiction.

Search Instagram and Facebook directly for a hookedbychristineco craft page and confirm any Farmington or greater-Hartford CT location signal.
Ask the merchant for a product description (currently null) and for links to any social or market-vendor presence, to close the businessModel and operating gaps.

summary: Nothing adverse was found on this merchant, but almost nothing was positively verified either: every dimension scores 0 because no contradiction was established, not because evidence was confirmed. The declared Etsy storefront could not be loaded in this session - the research fetch tool refused the URL and browser access to non-GitHub sites was not available on this unattended run - so the existence, age, listings and ownership of the shop all remain open. The positive signals that do exist are internal-coherence ones: the statement descriptor is a clean truncation of the declared shop URL rather than a random string, the business name describes a craft rather than payment collection, MCC 5399 is plausible for a handmade seller, the entity is an individual for whom no CT registration is expected, and Stripe reports the representative identity-verified with payouts enabled. Treat this as an unverified zero rather than a clean one: a quick manual browser pass on the Etsy shop is the single highest-value next step, because a shop that turns out to be absent or inactive would move operating to a 15-point contradiction.
